text: dsh-hold-to-talk 是面向 DSH Web 对话输入框的按住说话语音输入插件。它在 composer 输入框叠加录音状态和实时转写浮层，松开鼠标后将识别文本写入草稿，也可通过上滑取消；默认不会自动发送。语音由本机 SenseVoice 和 sherpa-onnx 识别，支持自动、中文、英文、日文、韩文及粤语识别。首次使用会按需下载语音模型到本地缓存，不需要 API Key。适合希望在 DSH 网页对话中口述长消息、减少键盘输入的用户。

dsh-hold-to-talk adds speech input to the DSH Web composer. Hold the mouse to record and see live transcription; release to insert text into the draft or slide upward to cancel. SenseVoice recognition runs locally. The model downloads on first use and is cached locally; no API key is needed.

dsh-hold-to-talk README · 🎤 It's listening but my words don't show up?：- Speak **clearly at a normal volume**. No need to shout—just your regular speaking voice is perfect.
.- Make sure your microphone is **not muted** and is **selected as the default device** in Windows Sound settings.
.- If you're in a noisy environment, try moving closer to your microphoneor using a headset mic.
